RELA has a clearer variant-specific allelic-binding result: its mapped model predicts stronger binding to alt T, while HMGA1’s two passing models disagree on direction (E13, E15). evidence.summary: ENCODE has no RELA ChIP-seq experiment in biosamples matching 'Hep 3B2.1-7', so ENCODE says nothing about it there, for or against. ENCODE assayed RELA in: GM12878, GM12891, GM12892, GM15510, GM18526, GM18951, GM19099, GM19193, HepG2, K562, WTC11. ReMap 2022 has no RELA peak over the variant (ReMap lists peaks only, so this is no evidence against binding).
